BehaviorTree._description: Turns joint k k times clockwise, one stage per turn, then returns every joint to its start position.

GetJointPositions._description: Records where every joint starts: stage 1 turns from here, and the return comes back here.

Sleep._description: No joint state received yet: waits 50 ms before the next attempt.

OffsetJointPositions._description: Subtracts one full turn (2π) from the current positions: a clockwise turn.

FollowJointTrajectory._description: Turns joints 1 to 5 one full turn clockwise in 3.5 s, the fastest the 3.14 rad/s² acceleration limit allows.

GetJointPositions._description: Reads where joints 2 to 5 are now, from /joint_states.

OffsetJointPositions._description: Subtracts one full turn (2π) from the current positions: a clockwise turn.

FollowJointTrajectory._description: Turns joints 2 to 5 one full turn clockwise in 3.5 s, the fastest the 3.14 rad/s² acceleration limit allows.

Returns every joint to its recorded start position in 8 s (joint 5 has 5 turns to undo).
